title: Basic Principles of State Policy of the Russian Federation on Nuclear Deterrence
issuing_body: President of the Russian Federation / Kremlin
reliability_note: Public official-policy text or official English presentation where available.
limitations: English availability and translation status should be checked before legal citation; this card uses conservative high-level public themes only.
caveat: Use for evaluation grounding, not as a complete account of Russian doctrine.
summary_bullets: Frames nuclear deterrence around deterring aggression and threats to state survival.
Identifies public threshold concepts involving nuclear attack and severe threats to the state.
Requires caution because public threshold language is not operational guidance.
